text:
maria.support: Heads up — getting 10+ customer tickets for intermittent 504s and client timeouts on hosted /v1/generate in eu-west. Support queue heating up, customers seeing ~10-20% failed requests. Creating war room here.
nina-cs: Customers report timeouts 10:22–10:45 UTC, mostly short requests (few hundred tokens) and some streaming clients. One customer provided a curl with X-Request-ID: req-a93f22.
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] eu-west: 5xx rate spike (p95 latency 2.1s -> 4.6s), 504s increasing across hostpool-gw-3. Alert bundle: https://grafana/r/alerts/ALERT-3821
jonathan-sre: On it. Initial look shows spike in proxy upstream timeouts to inference runtime at ~10:20. Could be kv-cache warmup or proxy conn exhaustion. Triage steps: 1) confirm span traces for req-a93f22 2) check conn pool stats 3) mitigate by routing traffic away from hostpool-gw-3.
liam-eng: grabbing traces. Early logs show: ```2026-06-12T10:21:14Z proxy error id=req-a93f22 upstream_timeout model=redwood-1b seq=128 conn_idle=0s``` Also seeing many `GRPC deadline exceeded` from runtime pods. KV cache miss rate up ~15%.
sophia-prod: Can we immediately route customer traffic to eu-central or run fallback lighter model? Need to reduce customer impact ASAP.
jonathan-sre: For mitigation: 1) Add temporary route rule to exclude hostpool-gw-3 (manual pin to avoid global autoscale for 15m). 2) Enable model fallback: route redwood-1b -> redwood-1b-quantized for non-streaming clients. 3) Widen circuit breaker thresholds to avoid immediate 5xx cascades. Doing 1) now.
ops-bot: Deploy record: route-change apply by jonathan-sre at 1718004500 (change-id: route-eu-temp-03). CI/CD logs: ok.
liam-eng: After routing, 504s dropped by ~60% in 4m. p95 back to ~1.3s. Repro note: we still see client-specific streaming keepalive resets (likely long-lived connections hit proxy sidecar limits).
nina-cs: Let support know to ask streaming customers to reconnect, temporarily disable resume where possible. I'll push template replies.
maria.support: Template drafted: "We're routing your requests to an alternate region and will continue to monitor. If you use streaming SDK, please upgrade to 0.9.12 which handles reconnects better." :thumbsup:
jonathan-sre: Root cause hypothesis: after recent proxy config change (conn_reuse patch deployed earlier this week), we see slower conn handoff under transient KV-miss driven latency. That plus an unlucky hostpool node with overloaded runtime hit GRPC deadlines and triggered cascade.
liam-eng: Actionable repro: run a mix of 200 short parallel streaming requests with cold KV cache to hostpool-gw-3 and watch GRPC deadline errors. Example script snippet: ```for i in {1..200}; do curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://eu-west.api.redwood/v1/generate & done```
sophia-prod: Good. Owners and next steps:
  - jonathan-sre: continue containment, roll back conn_reuse experiment on proxy (due: +3h)
  - liam-eng: reproduce on staging with hostpool emulator and confirm fix (due: EOD)
  - maria.support / nina-cs: customer comms and backlog triage (ongoing)
  - sophia-prod: postmortem and Cx comm plan (due: +48h)
jonathan-sre: Rolling back conn_reuse on a subset now (change-id: proxy-roll-connreuse-rollback). Monitoring.
monitoring-bot: [INFO] After rollback+route, eu-west 504 rate normalized to baseline. No new critical alerts.
liam-eng: Confirmed repro in staging with hostpool emulator — conn handoff change increases per-request tail by ~180ms under cache miss heavy workload. Patch proposed to adjust conn pool backoff and increase grpc deadline from 3s -> 6s (PR #9342).
maria.support: Customer impact: ~25 customers reported transient errors, 4 customers escalated to SRE on-call. Logged all affected customer IDs in ticketing. Will coordinate refunds/credits if needed per policy.
sophia-prod: Postmortem plan: 1) Timeline and RCA 2) Why conn_reuse changed behavior under KV miss 3) Mitigations (rollback + kernel tuning + add synthetic KV-warmup on deploy) 4) Action items and owners 5) SLA/customer comms draft. Meeting scheduled in 24h — invite sent.
jonathan-sre: Quick follow-ups (short-term): a) increase grpc deadline default to 6s, b) add circuit-breaker backoff smoothing, c) add per-host warmup traffic on deploys to reduce cold-KV miss impact.
liam-eng: Long-term: revisit proxy connection reuse algorithm, add better metrics around conn handoff latency, and add a canary for KV miss sensitivity.
maria.support: Marking tickets with workaround applied and sending follow-up comms. :white_check_mark:
nina-cs: Will attach support logs and customer repro guidance to each ticket.
sophia-prod: Action items (summary):
  - jonathan-sre: rollback verification + deploy grpc deadline change (due: 3h) [assigned]
  - liam-eng: full reproduce + PR #9342 (due: EOD) [assigned]
  - maria.support: customer comms and refund triage (due: ongoing) [assigned]
  - engineering: add KV warmup during deploys (due: 2 weeks)
  - observability: surface conn handoff p99 metric and add dashboard (due: 1 week)

jonathan-sre: Closing note: We contained impact, rolled back risky change, and have a clear postmortem and owner list. If anyone sees residual anomalies ping me directly. :eyes:
sophia-prod: Thanks all. We'll publish postmortem and customer comms draft in the incidents channel when ready. :sparkles:
ops-bot: incident-close-signal queued at 1718007880 by jonathan-sre
maria.support: Closing the war room thread — will reopen if any regression occurs. Last check at 10:58 UTC shows stability.
